Let me try a different approach - use curl via run_command to get the arXiv data directly:

```bash
curl -s "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:%22multimodal+retrieval+augmented%22&start=0&max_results=8&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending" -o arxiv_results.xml
wc -c arxiv_results.xml
```
